verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents official MCP servers at its developer docs (mcp/overview). They work with any MCP-capable AI tool, including Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code and Windsurf, and expose CRM operations such as COQL queries and bulk record operations via natural language. A probe confirms the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server in use, and detail on auth and setup depth.
